title: The Dragon Hunt
description: The time has come. You've prepared, you've planned, and now you face the legendary krayt dragon. This is no ordinary hunt—this creature is massive, intelligent, and extremely dangerous. But the rewards are legendary: a krayt dragon pearl, bones for crafting, and the respect of every hunter in the Outer Rim. The hunt begins now.
shortDescription: Hunt and defeat the legendary krayt dragon

objectives.description: Travel to the krayt dragon's lair in the Jundland Wastes
Navigate through the dangerous wastes to reach the dragon's lair at the deepest point
Defeat the legendary krayt dragon in its lair
Recover the krayt dragon pearl from the defeated dragon
Recover krayt dragon bones (search the dragon's remains)
